rows.name: Hida Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Heavy Weapons (Tetsubo), Intimidation, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei Skill

lore.text: One of the Empire's oldest bushi styles, forged against the Shadowlands: endure the enemy's blows, then crush them with heavy weapons.

rows.name: Hida Pragmatist [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu (Improvised Weapons) 2, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei Skill

lore.text: Students of Kobo Ichi-Kai, taught at Clear Water Village, who put unarmed fighting above every other kind. Their strength makes them fine yojimbo and a match even for Shadowlands creatures.

rows.name: Hiruma Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics, Hunting, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth, any one Skill

lore.text: Where the Hida endure, the Hiruma evade, striking weak points with lightning speed. Their School is built for movement and survival inside the Shadowlands.

rows.name: Kaiu Engineer [Artisan/Bushi]
rows.skills: Battle, Craft: Armorsmithing, Craft: Weaponsmithing, Defense, Engineering, Lore: Architecture, War Fan

lore.text: The Empire's foremost builders, siege engineers and armourers, devoted to the Crab's defence against the Shadowlands. Many also lead troops, turning siegecraft to war.

rows.name: Kuni Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Defense, Lore: Shadowlands 2, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one Weapon Skill

lore.text: Thought of as obsessive madmen who delve into forbidden secrets, the Kuni accept that as the price of fighting the Shadowlands. Their alliance with the Nezumi gives them insight into other nonhumans.

rows.name: Kuni Witch-Hunter [Monk]
rows.skills: Investigation, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Lore: Maho, Meditation, any one Skill

lore.text: A small band of mystic warriors who roam the Empire hunting maho-tsukai and Shadowlands infiltrators, ignoring borders. Commoners welcome them; other samurai often do not.

rows.name: Toritaka Bushi
rows.skills: Animal Handling (Falcons), Hunting 2, Kenjutsu, Etiquette, Lore: Spirit Realms, Spears, any one Skill

lore.text: Specialists in destroying creatures from other spirit realms, with a fluid style for unexpected monsters: potent against the otherworldly, less so against people.

rows.name: Yasuki Courtier
rows.skills: Commerce (Appraisal), Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation, Sincerity (Deceit), any one Merchant Skill

lore.text: Once Crane, the Yasuki joined the Crab and became the Empire's richest merchants. Their courtiers are salesmen who find what a rival needs and supply it, at a price.

rows.name: Hiruma Scout [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Hunting, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth (Sneaking), any one Bugei Skill

lore.text: After Hiruma Castle fell, the family lost the teachers of its old bushi School. The Hiruma Scouts are the stealthy style practised in that era.

rows.name: Asahina Shugenja
rows.skills: any one Artisan Skill, Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High Skill

lore.text: Part priests and part monks, the Asahina value preserving life over destruction, treat every ritual as a lesson and prize the making of art. Their magic leans towards protection.

rows.name: Daidoji Iron Warrior [Bushi]
rows.skills: Battle, Defense 2, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, any one Skill

lore.text: The Crane's quiet strength: heavy infantry and yojimbo who win the day when words fail, with Techniques for enduring blows and guarding others.

rows.name: Daidoji Scout [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Hunting (Traps), Kenjutsu, Knives, Kyujutsu (Yumi), Stealth (Sneaking), any 1 Bugei or Low Skill

lore.text: A Daidoji style of scouting, ambush and precise strikes at commanders and supply lines. Its scouts use traps and surprise, accepting some dishonour for the good of the Crane.

rows.name: Doji Courtier
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Courtier (Manipulation), Etiquette (Courtesy), Perform: Storytelling, Sincerity, Tea Ceremony, any one Artisan or Perform skill

lore.text: The source of the Crane's mastery of court. The Doji School builds vast networks of allies through favours and obligations, with a curriculum broad enough to meet any need.

rows.name: Doji Magistrate [Bushi]
rows.skills: Defense, Horsemanship, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Knives (Jitte), Polearms, any High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: Crane magistrates trained to fight with compassion, avoiding injury where they can and favouring weapons such as the jitte and sasumata that disarm or capture.

rows.name: Kakita Bushi
rows.skills: Etiquette, Iaijutsu (Focus), Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Sincerity, Tea Ceremony, any one Bugei or High Skill

lore.text: The Kakita Dueling Academy is devoted to iaijutsu above all. Its champions decide battles before they begin and answer any challenge at court.

rows.name: Kakita Artisan
rows.skills: Courtier, Games: Sadane, Etiquette, Sincerity, any 3 skills from Acting/Artisan/Perform

lore.text: The Kakita Artisan Academy studies every art, performed or crafted, and how each can serve the Crane Clan.

rows.name: Kitsuki Investigator [Courtier]
rows.skills: Courtier, Etiquette (Courtesy), Investigation (Interrogation), Kenjutsu, Meditation, Sincerity, any one Lore Skill
tech: Know the Rhythm of the Heart

lore.text: Alone in the Empire, the Kitsuki believe in evidence. Their School hones near-perfect memory and observation, making them the Dragon's courtiers and natural magistrates.

rows.name: Mirumoto Bushi
rows.skills: Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: Shugenja, Meditation, Lore: Theology, any one Bugei or High Skill
tech: The Calm in Midst of Thunder

lore.text: The only School that teaches Niten, fighting with katana and wakizashi together, which fuels a long rivalry with the Kakita's single-sword style.

rows.name: Mirumoto Taoist Swordsman [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: Theology, Meditation, any 1 Bugei or High Skill

lore.text: Swordsmen who train beside the Togashi tattooed monks and bring their unconventional methods to the blade.

rows.name: Tamori Shugenja
rows.skills: Athletics, Calligraphy (Cipher), Defense, Divination, Lore: Theology, Medicine, Spellcraft

lore.text: Formed from the Agasha who stayed with the Dragon, the Tamori inherited their experimental magic, notably sealing a spell's essence in prepared liquids for later use.

rows.name: The Togashi Tattooed Order [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Artisan: Tattooing, Defense, Jiujutsu, any one Lore Skill, Meditation, any one non-Low Skill

lore.text: The ise zumi, whose tattoos, inked with the Kami Togashi's blood, grant supernatural powers. Revered and feared, they excel at unarmed combat and feats of athleticism.

rows.name: The Hoshi Tsurui Zumi Order [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Meditation (Void Recovery), any 2 Skills

lore.text: A branch of the Togashi tattooed monks begun in the Hidden Emperor era, when Togashi Hoshi broke with Hitomi and began tattooing his own followers.

rows.name: The Hitomi Kikage Zumi Order [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore (choose one), Meditation, any 2 Non-Low Skills

lore.text: Tattooed monks, mostly of the Hitomi family, who seek enlightenment through violent physical action. They flourish under Lady Hitomi but appear in other eras too.

rows.name: Akodo Bushi
rows.skills: Battle (Mass Combat), Defense, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: History, Sincerity, any one Bugei or High Skill

lore.text: The Akodo refuse narrow specialisation: their School perfects precise, fundamental kenjutsu and pairs it with a thorough study of battle.

rows.name: Ikoma Bard [Courtier]
rows.skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: History (Lion Clan), Perform: Storytelling, Sincerity (Honesty), any one High Skill, any one Bugei Skill

lore.text: The Empire's great storytellers. Ikoma bards argue through history and parable, invoking ancestors and heroes to win debates and spread Glory.

rows.name: Ikoma Lion’s Shadow [Bushi]
rows.skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Kenjutsu, Investigation (Notice), Sincerity, Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill

lore.text: A small, secretive School that keeps alive the ruthless, pragmatic methods of the first Ikoma, which the family's histories prefer to forget.

rows.name: Kitsu Shugenja
rows.skills: Battle, Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: Keeping rituals unchanged since the family began, the Kitsu sense and work the bonds between the living, their ancestors and other realms, and command large-scale battle magic.

rows.name: Lion Elite Spearmen [Bushi]
rows.skills: Battle, Defense, Kenjutsu, Lore: History, Polearms, Spears (Magari-Yari), any one Bugei or High Skill

lore.text: The Lion's spear units are few in modern times and other Clans see them as a relic of an earlier age. Several escort the new Miya Governor of Naishou Province.

rows.name: Matsu Beastmaster [Bushi]
rows.skills: Animal Handling 2, Battle, Defense, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu, any 1 Bugei Skill
tech: With the Soul of a Lion

lore.text: Matsu who take lion warcats into their own pride and communicate with them almost mystically, though the bond can leave them awkward among people.

rows.name: Matsu Berserker [Bushi]
rows.skills: Battle, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: History, any two Bugei Skills

lore.text: Most Matsu train here. The School teaches total, fearless commitment to the attack, on the principle that a beaten foe cannot strike back.

rows.name: Agasha Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), any one Craft Skill, Defense, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: Agasha shugenja pursue unconventional magic, from alchemy to spells that call on several elements at once, and the Phoenix let them take that study as far as it leads.

rows.name: Asako Henshin [Monk]
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Lore: Elements, Lore: Theology, Meditation 2, any 1 Skill (not Low)

lore.text: A secretive monastic sect of the Asako whose ways few outside the family understand. Its monks study how a person relates to the Elements that make up all things.

rows.name: Asako Loremaster [Courtier]
rows.skills: Courtier, Etiquette (Courtesy), Lore: History, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, Sincerity, any Lore Skill

lore.text: Scholarly Asako courtiers who study an unusually wide range of subjects and turn that learning into insight and influence at court.

rows.name: Isawa Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Lore: Theology, any one Lore Skill, Medicine, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High Skill

lore.text: The oldest shugenja School in Rokugan and the largest shugenja family. The Isawa have pursued the secrets of the universe for more than a thousand years.

rows.name: Shiba Artisan [Courtier]
rows.skills: Artisan (pick 2), Calligraphy, Etiquette, Lore (pick 1), Sincerity, any 1 High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: A quiet Shiba tradition that seeks to capture beauty as purely as possible; unlike the Kakita, a Shiba artist needs no audience.

rows.name: Shiba Bushi
rows.skills: Defense, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Meditation (Void Recovery), Spears, Lore: Theology, any one Bugei or High Skill

lore.text: Warrior-scholars who look for any alternative to bloodshed, then strike swiftly when it comes. Their Techniques draw on the Void and protect others, suiting them to yojimbo work.

rows.name: Bayushi Bushi
rows.skills: Courtier (Manipulation), Defense, Etiquette, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu, Sincerity, any one Skill
tech: Strike From Above Strike From Below
The Pincers Hold, The Tail Strikes

lore.text: The School behind the Scorpion's villainous reputation trains its students as agents of discord, adding manipulation, stealth and even poison to their swordplay. Its Techniques are dirty tricks that exploit every advantage.

rows.name: Bayushi Courtier
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Courtier (Gossip), Etiquette, Investigation, Sincerity (Deceit), Temptation, any one High skill

lore.text: Masters of manipulation whose patient gathering of secrets built the Scorpion's network of informants. They find the weakness in any opponent, or ally, and use it for the Clan.

rows.name: Shosuro Actor [Ninja]
rows.skills: Acting, Etiquette, Knives, Meditation, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill

lore.text: Shinobi who infiltrate in plain sight, disguised as servants, peasants or even particular samurai, which is why the Shosuro have long practised acting.

rows.name: Shosuro Infiltrator [Ninja]
rows.skills: Acting, Athletics, Ninjutsu, Sincerity, Stealth (Sneaking) 2, any one Skill

lore.text: A School few outsiders know exists, training silent killers who strike unsuspecting targets from hiding, without pleasure or remorse.

rows.name: Soshi Magistrate [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Intimidation (Control), Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Underworld, any Bugei Skill

lore.text: Grown from techniques taught to the yoriki of Soshi Saibankan, this School trains the Scorpion's magistrates and guards in both armed and unarmed fighting.

rows.name: Soshi Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, Stealth, any 1 Skill

lore.text: Called in when stealth and subtlety are needed, Soshi shugenja coax the amoral kami into trickery and can cast most non-damaging spells without any visible sign.

rows.name: Yogo Wardmaster [Shugenja]
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Investigation, Lore: Theology, Spellcraft, Stealth, any 1 High or Low Skill

lore.text: Shugenja of the Yogo's closely guarded ward magic: protective charms more flexible than the Toritaka's exorcism wards.

rows.name: Horiuchi Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Craft: Meishodo, Defense, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft (Spell Research), any 1 High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: Keepers of meishodo, the talisman magic the Unicorn gathered from many peoples on their travels beyond the Empire. In earlier eras the Iuchi teach it.

rows.name: Ide Emissary [Courtier]
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Commerce, Courtier, Etiquette (Conversation), Horsemanship, Sincerity (Honesty), any one High or Perform skill

lore.text: The most peaceable courtiers of the Great Clans, the Ide cultivate calm and mediation. Their Techniques never attack; they defuse conflict and protect the Emissary.

rows.name: Iuchi Shugenja
rows.skills: Battle, Calligraphy (Cipher), Horsemanship, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: Free-spirited and unconventional, the Iuchi learned much of their craft on the open plains during the Unicorn's wanderings, meishodo talismans included. Their magic favours speed and travel.

rows.name: Moto Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Horsemanship, Hunting, Kenjutsu (Scimitar), any one Bugei Skill, any one Skill

lore.text: Descended in part from the nomads who joined the Unicorn abroad, the Moto fight as unrestrained heavy cavalry, a style other Clans find both fearsome and improper.

rows.name: Moto Death Priest [Shugenja]
rows.skills: Athletics, Horsemanship, Hunting, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any 1 Skill

lore.text: Followers of the Shi-Tien Yen-Wang, a wrathful pantheon of foreign death gods, who turn those gods' disfavour on their enemies.

rows.name: Moto Vindicator [Bushi]
rows.skills: Horsemanship, Hunting, Investigation (Notice), Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any 1 Bugei Skill

lore.text: Born of the shame of Moto Tsume's fall into the Shadowlands, the Vindicators swore to destroy the Tainted Moto and every Shadowlands creature.

rows.name: Shinjo Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Horsemanship 2, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, any 1 Skill

lore.text: Mounted fighters whose style adopts foreign methods from the Unicorn's travels, such as the active parry and riposte, unfamiliar to most Rokugani.

rows.name: Utaku Battle Maiden [Bushi]
rows.skills: Battle, Defense, Horsemanship 2, Kenjutsu, Sincerity, any one High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: The shiotome, the most respected cavalry in the Empire and the only riders allowed to breed the Utaku steeds. Honor strengthens their mounted Techniques.

rows.name: Utaku Mounted Infantry [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Battle, Defense, Kenjutsu, Polearms, Spears, any one Bugei or High Skill

lore.text: Soldiers who ride to battle and fight on foot, developed during the Unicorn's wanderings; many are Otaku men barred by tradition from fighting on horseback.

rows.name: Chuda Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Hunting, Lore: Maho, Lore: Shadowlands, Spellcraft, Stealth, any one Skill

lore.text: Heirs of the destroyed Snake Clan, the Chuda keep a secret tradition of maho centuries old and now serve the Spider, always pushing blood magic further whatever it costs.

rows.name: Daigotsu Bushi
rows.skills: Hunting, Intimidation, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, Lore: Shadowlands, any one Bugei or Low Skill

lore.text: Spider Clan warriors whose style is pieced together from the Schools they knew in their former lives. Eclectic but brutal, it can even feed on a dying foe's life force.

rows.name: Daigotsu Courtier
rows.skills: Acting, Courtier (Manipulation), Etiquette, Meditation, Sincerity (Deceit), Temptation, any one High Skill

lore.text: Spider courtiers who slip into the courts of the Great Clans in disguise, using blackmail and contacts to steer rivals into conflict while hiding their own Taint.

rows.name: Goju Ninja
rows.skills: Athletics, Kenjutsu, Ninjutsu, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth 2, any one Skill

lore.text: The faceless servants of the Lying Darkness, people whose identities the Nothing has consumed. They draw on it for infiltration, deception and murder.

rows.name: Ninube Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Knives, Sincerity (Lying), Spellcraft, Stealth 2, any Low skill

lore.text: Called shugenja only for convenience, the Ninube are no longer truly individuals; their power, like the Goju's, comes from the Nothing.

rows.name: The Order of the Spider Monks [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Polearms, any one Skill

lore.text: Begun with the fallen monk Roshungi and spread by his student Michio, the Order teaches each follower to find their own path whatever it costs others.

rows.name: Miya Herald [Courtier]
rows.skills: Courtier (Rhetoric), Defense, Etiquette (Courtesy), Horsemanship, Lore: Heraldry, Sincerity, any 1 High or Bugei skill

lore.text: Imperial messengers who carry the Emperor's word to every corner of Rokugan. They build trust, calm disputes and can defend themselves on dangerous roads.

rows.name: Otomo Courtier
rows.skills: Courtier (Manipulation), Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation (Control), Investigation, Sincerity, any 1 High Skill

lore.text: Imperial courtiers who protect the throne by sowing suspicion among the Great Clans. They trade on Imperial authority and use every underhanded trick, safe behind their bloodline.

rows.name: Seppun Guardsman [Bushi]
rows.skills: Battle, Defense, Etiquette, Iaijutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), Kyujutsu, any 1 High Skill

lore.text: The Miharu, who give up everything to guard the Imperial House. Their School puts defence, and the life of the one they protect, above the guardsman's own.

rows.name: Seppun Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Defense, Etiquette, Investigation (Notice), Meditation, Lore: Theology, any 1 High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: The Hidden Guard: shugenja who keep constant watch against threats steel cannot answer, with some of the finest wards in Rokugan, as the Emperor's last line of defence.

rows.name: Ichiro Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics, Commerce, Defense, Heavy Weapons, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu (Katana), any High or Bugei skill

lore.text: Founded by a Hida, the Badger's School stays close to its Crab roots: wrestling, unarmed fighting and sheer strength that answers finesse with overwhelming force.

rows.name: Komori Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Lore: Ancestors, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, Tea Ceremony, any one High Skill

lore.text: The Bat Clan's shugenja draw on the koumori, kindly bat spirits of Chikushudo, for strange spells and swift messages across the Empire.

rows.name: Heichi Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Intimidation, Kenjutsu, Spears (Mai Chong), any one Bugei Skill

lore.text: Shaped by the dangers of the Boar lands, Heichi bushi take the enemy's worst and keep fighting. The School favours the rare curved Mai Chong spear and a patient, defensive style.

rows.name: Tonbo Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Courtier, Etiquette, Meditation (Void Recovery), Sincerity, Spellcraft, any one High Skill

lore.text: Deeply spiritual priests of the mountains who also serve as go-betweens for the Dragon at court, using their bond with the spirits to sharpen their social graces.

rows.name: Toritaka Bushi
rows.skills: Animal Handling (Falcons), Hunting 2, Kenjutsu, Etiquette, Lore: Spirit Realms, Spears, any one Skill

lore.text: Specialists in destroying creatures from other spirit realms, with a fluid style for unexpected monsters: potent against the otherworldly, less so against people.

rows.name: Kitsune Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Defense, Hunting, Medicine (Herbalism), Meditation, Spellcraft, any one High or Bugei skill

lore.text: Living beside one of Rokugan's great forests, Fox shugenja learn to love its spirits and creatures, and their School deepens the bond between people and animals.

rows.name: Usagi Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics (Running), Defense, Hunting, Jiujutsu, Kenjutsu, Lore: Maho, any one High or Bugei skill

lore.text: Tested by centuries of war, the Hare's School turns their athleticism into hit-and-run attacks that seem to come from every side.

rows.name: Mantis Brawler [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Commerce, Intimidation, Jiujutsu, Knives, Sailing, any 1 Weapon Skill

lore.text: Born of shipboard fights and tavern brawls among the Mantis Clan's pirates and smugglers, a fighting style even less conventional than the Yoritomo's.

rows.name: Moshi Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Divination, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Spellcraft, any two High or Bugei Skills

lore.text: Long devoted to the Sun Goddess, the Moshi turned to practical weather magic after joining the Mantis and often sail on Yoritomo ships to calm the seas.

rows.name: Tsuruchi Archer [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Investigation, Kyujutsu (Yumi) 2, any one Bugei or High Skill

lore.text: The Empire's finest archers since their days as the Wasp Clan, devoted to the purity of the bow: deadly at range, outclassed in melee.

rows.name: Tsuruchi Bounty Hunter [Bushi]
rows.skills: Athletics, Hunting (Tracking), Intimidation, Investigation, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Underworld

lore.text: The Wasp Clan once lived by hunting fugitives for the Emerald Champion; a few Tsuruchi still learn that relentless trade as a School of its own.

rows.name: Yoritomo Bushi
rows.skills: Commerce, Defense, Jiujutsu (Improved Weapons), Kenjutsu, Knives (Kama), Sailing, any one Skill

lore.text: Fighters shaped by ship-to-ship combat, with fluid movement, a habit of exploiting weaknesses quickly and skill with peasant weapons that stand up to sea air.

rows.name: Yoritomo Courtier
rows.skills: Commerce (Appraisal), Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Intimidation (Control), Sincerity, any one Merchant or Lore skill

lore.text: Created to serve the Mantis's trade, these courtiers rely on intimidation and bullying, a style that has found more success since the Mantis became a Great Clan.

rows.name: Yoritomo Shugenja
rows.skills: Athletics, Calligraphy, Knives, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Sailing (Navigation), any 1 Skill

lore.text: A small Yoritomo line, begun with a daughter of the Mantis founder, with an unmatched bond to the spirits of the sea and storm.

rows.name: Toku Bushi
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Hunting, Investigation (Search), Kenjutsu, Lore: History, any 1 High or Bugei Skill

lore.text: The Monkey Clan's School teaches calm against overwhelming odds and fighting many foes at once.

rows.name: Fuzake Shugenja
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Defense, Etiquette, Lore: Theology, Medicine, Spellcraft, any one High or Merchant Skill

lore.text: Begun as ronin shugenja in Toturi's Army under Yasuki Garou, a friend of Toku, the Fuzake swore to the Monkey Clan and devote themselves to healing and an eccentric reverence for the Fortunes.

rows.name: Tsi Smith [Artisan]
rows.skills: Any one Artisan Skill, Commerce, two ranks in any one Craft Skill, Defense, any one Weapon Skill, any one High, Bugei, or Merchant Skill

lore.text: Named for a foreign smith honoured by the second Emperor and revived by a ronin centuries later, the School forges weapons and armour and learns to fight so it knows how they are used.

rows.name: Morito Bushi
rows.skills: Defense, Horsemanship, Hunting (Tracking), Kenjutsu, Lore: Kolat, Lore: Underworld, any one Skill

lore.text: The Ox Clan's heavy cavalry, trained to ride down infantry and make the most of a horse's speed; most fight with a polearm.

rows.name: Chuda Shugenja [Snake]
rows.skills: Calligraphy (Cipher), Etiquette, Lore: Maho, Lore: Shadowlands, Spellcraft, any 2 Skills

lore.text: The Snake Clan's original School, founded by an Imperial magistrate sworn to destroy maho-tsukai. Its shugenja hunted Tainted sorcerers and their monsters with Earth and Jade magic.

rows.name: Suzume Bushi
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Kenjutsu (Katana), Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Perform: Storytelling, any one Lore Skill, any one Skill

lore.text: Founded from Crane samurai, the Sparrow keep a katana style that waits for the perfect strike, and their love of stories helps them read the flow of battle.

rows.name: Kasuga Smuggler [Courtier]
rows.skills: Commerce, Etiquette, Investigation (Notice), Lore: Underworld, Sincerity (Deceit), Stealth, any one High, Merchant, or Low Skill

lore.text: Tortoise agents who move among the Empire's criminals, ruthless and steeped in the underworld, finding allies wherever they can, even among honest peasants.

rows.name: Yotsu Bushi School (Heroes of Rokugan) [Bushi]
rows.skills: Commerce, Hunting, Kenjutsu, Kyujutsu, any one Skill from Lore: Gaijin or Lore: Shadowlands, Stealth (Sneaking), any one Low or Bugei Skill

lore.text: From the ronin family that guarded the commoners of Otosan Uchi, the School grew into a full bushi style while fighting the Spider in the capital's ruins. In the Heroes of Rokugan timeline the Yotsu become the Tiger Clan.

rows.name: The Four Temples [Monk]
rows.skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: Monks who believe enlightenment requires staying engaged with society. With a great monastery in the Imperial capital, they advise lords and help travellers.

rows.name: The Order of Heroes [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (pick an Emphasis), Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: A little-known sect that believes anyone can become a hero. It quietly finds threats to the Empire and the people able to meet them.

rows.name: The Shrine of the Seven Thunders [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Lore (pick one), Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: Monks who honour the seven heroes who defeated Fu Leng by devoting their lives to contemplation, rarely leaving their monastery.

rows.name: The Temple of Kaimetsu-uo [Monk]
rows.skills: Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, any three Skills

lore.text: Followers of the Mantis founder who believe he left to avoid a ruinous fight over the Crab's leadership; they seek enlightenment through conciliation and peace.

rows.name: The Temple of Osano-Wo [Monk]
rows.skills: Battle, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, any two Bugei Skills

lore.text: Perhaps the most militant Brotherhood sect, devoted to physical prowess and martial arts; its monks ritually scar themselves to mark their progress.

rows.name: The Temples of the Thousand Fortunes [Monk]
rows.skills: Jiujutsu, Lore: History, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), any one Lore Skill, Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: A varied network of temples to Rokugan's countless Fortunes, whose monks mostly believe they must work hard to prove worthy of enlightenment.

rows.name: Order of the Wind [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Staves, any one Skill

lore.text: Brothers who accept that the world is chaotic and unpredictable and stay steady within it, gaining command of themselves and, quietly, a little of the world around them.

rows.name: Wind’s Grace Order [Monk]
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Kyujutsu, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: Formed after the Clan War for monks who could not regain their peace after defending the temples. Archery gave them focus, and the order keeps ties to the Asahina and other archery traditions.

rows.name: Fukurokujin’s Eyes [Monk]
rows.skills: Calligraphy, Divination, Etiquette, Investigation, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, any one non-Bugei Skill

lore.text: A hereditary order of a few bloodlines descended from a tribe older than the Kami's arrival, valued by the Crab for uncannily accurate judgement and prediction.

rows.name: The Order of the Nameless Gift [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu, Lore (pick one), Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: An offshoot of the Shrine of the Seven Thunders that seeks the Thunders' fate-changing power in every soul through physical rigour and trials of endurance, taking the world plainly as it is.

rows.name: Temple of Persistence [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Defense, Jiujutsu (Martial Arts), Lore: Theology, Meditation, any one Bugei Skill, any one Skill

lore.text: A largely martial order devoted to unyielding endurance. Its training tests body, mind and spirit to their limits, and its stubborn monks rarely accept defeat.

rows.name: The Order of Rebirth [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: Descended from militant sohei of Osano-Wo, these brothers embrace new paths and philosophies to uncover new truths, earning other sects' disdain.

rows.name: Tengoku’s Fist [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Battle, Jiujutsu 2, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any one Skill

lore.text: A friendly offshoot of the Shrine of the Seven Thunders, these sohei see violence as a natural part of life: never a first resort, but an option they use exceptionally well.

rows.name: The Temple of Heavenly Wisdom [Monk]
rows.skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Lore: History, Lore: Theology, Meditation, Sincerity, any one High Skill

lore.text: Perhaps the oldest monastic tradition in Crane lands. Its ancient temple helped the Lady Doji spread culture and won its monks unusual prestige.

rows.name: The Order of Jurojin’s Blessing [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Jiujutsu, Lore: Anatomy (Disease), Medicine (Disease, Herbalism), Meditation, Staves, any one Skill

lore.text: Founded during the Great Famine to tend the sick of every caste; some members also treat injuries and, in later centuries, madness.

rows.name: The Shrine of Heaven’s Mirror [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Divination (Omens), Jiujutsu, Lore: Omens, Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: Ascetics who seek trance states, through sleeplessness, drink, wild dance and visionary plants, to receive guidance from the Fortunes and spirits, above all through omens.

rows.name: The Order of Eternity [Monk]
rows.skills: Defense, Divination (Astrology), Jiujutsu, Meditation, Lore: Theology, any two High Skills

lore.text: Monks who study the nature of time and wait for the right moment to act. Their long stillness and sudden action can make them seem odd, even mad.

rows.name: Shinmaki Order [Monk]
rows.skills: Divination, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology (Diamond Sutra), Meditation 2, any two Skills

lore.text: A small, controversial sect that studies the Diamond Sutra and meditates on the Seven Thunders in dark, isolated monasteries, emerging only now and then.

rows.name: First Dawn Scholars [Monk]
rows.skills: Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Nonhumans, Lore: Theology (Fortunes), Meditation, Staves, any one Skill

lore.text: In the Togashi Dynasty setting, the Owl Clan's monastic order: keepers of a library on civilisations older than humanity, who seek enlightenment in the world before the Kami fell.

rows.name: Order of the Five Rings [Monk]
rows.skills: Courtier, Defense, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Elements, Lore: Theology (Shintao), Meditation

lore.text: A short-lived order devoted to the charismatic monk Gorinno and his heretical philosophy, its members growing ever more zealous and cult-like.

rows.name: Fudoist Order [Monk]
rows.skills: Courtier, Etiquette, Jiujutsu, Lore: Theology, Meditation, any two Skills

lore.text: Monks of Fudoism, a heresy the Brotherhood of Shinsei has banned. Each must choose a personal path, and their Technique turns the gap in Honor between them and a foe into an edge.

rows.name: Order of Peaceful Repose [Monk]
rows.skills: Athletics, Calligraphy, Jiujutsu, Lore: Ghosts, Lore: Theology (Emma-O), Meditation, any one Skill

lore.text: Monks of Emma-O who lay ghosts to rest wherever war or local conditions make them common, whether the dead were peasants or samurai.

loreSample.text: One of the Empire's oldest bushi styles, forged against the Shadowlands: endure the enemy's blows, then crush them with heavy weapons.
